summary: Adds a compound output option to ms format (e.g. 1h 30m), with tests and README docs. The format still has to be changed to be Go time.ParseDuration-compatible (e.g. 25h30m).
narrative: The compound option was added to format() and committed with extra tests as 6b7b16e. In a second conversation the owner changed the plan: deploy logs are scraped by a Go service using time.ParseDuration, so the output must be glued parts with hours as the largest unit (25h30m). They deferred that change and first asked for parse() to tolerate surrounding whitespace, since YAML configs produce it. That was fixed with tests and committed as 4dc0103. A third conversation documented the compound format in the README and extended the tests, committed as 99094c3. The ParseDuration-compatible change has not yet been made. The README and tests describe the old space-separated format, so they will need rework. No PR or release has been recorded.
